Before you explore

A few helpful answers.

Do I need to install anything?

No. The website and hosted Flutter demonstration open in a browser. The ZIP also includes a standalone website file that opens by double-clicking it.

Does the demo use real patient records?

No. Use synthetic information only. Browser-local data is not a secure, shared hospital record.

Can I use every feature in shared mode?

No. The Node.js pilot supports selected workflows. Other actions are unavailable, and the local database is not automatically synchronized.

Is the AI a medical adviser?

No. Example summaries and connected report explanations are drafts. Live clinical AI and no-show risk scoring are not approved for operational use.

Will the app send an SMS or charge a bank card?

Not in the demonstrated scope. External delivery is incomplete and the local payment gateway is simulated. The shared pilot can record desk payments without processing a bank charge.

Can I use the app in Arabic?

The application includes Arabic and right-to-left layouts as well as English. Full human accessibility and language acceptance is still open. The narrow shared-pilot PDF renderer also needs an Arabic-capable replacement before claiming bilingual PDF delivery.
